configurations.name: dev
runtimeArgs: source $HOME/.nvm/nvm.sh && nvm use 24 >/dev/null && exec pnpm dev

configurations.name: dev-preview
runtimeArgs: source $HOME/.nvm/nvm.sh && nvm use 24 >/dev/null && exec pnpm dev

configurations.name: agent-server
runtimeArgs: source $HOME/.nvm/nvm.sh && nvm use 24 >/dev/null && AGENT_RUNTIME_PORT=$PORT exec pnpm agent:server

configurations.name: prod-preview
runtimeArgs: source $HOME/.nvm/nvm.sh && nvm use 24 >/dev/null && pnpm build && exec pnpm preview
